title: Rafael and the Garden
author: Beatrix Vane
blurb: Marguerite Vasquez, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
